##### Project general facts

Etérea by Zoya Developments is a refined residential project offering fully furnished one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom residences, thoughtfully designed for modern living. Each home combines practical layouts, natural light, and a calm contemporary atmosphere to create a comfortable and elegant living experience.

Residents can enjoy a well-rounded selection of amenities, including an open swimming pool, gym area, rooftop lounge, kids’ play area, pool area, lobby area, and barbecue area. Surrounded by greenery and open spaces, the amenities create a relaxing environment that encourages residents to enjoy both active and peaceful moments.

The residences are fully furnished and feature thoughtfully curated interiors created for comfort and modern lifestyles. Warm textures, refined contemporary finishes, expansive windows, and carefully considered details bring a welcoming sense of quality and sophistication to every space.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a thriving district in Dubai, boasting a vast expanse of landscape and a strategic location that offers unparalleled access to major cities. With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road, providing seamless connectivity to Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises a diverse range of residential complexes, iconic towers, hotels, and mixed-use units, creating a vibrant and dynamic community.

The proximity of Majan to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities makes it an attractive destination for families and professionals alike. The area's excellent infrastructure and affordable prices make it an ideal location for those seeking a comfortable and convenient lifestyle without the high costs associated with living in central Dubai. Majan's unique blend of natural beauty, modern amenities, and strategic location makes it a highly sought-after destination.

Majan's community is continually evolving, with new developments and amenities being added to enhance the quality of life for its residents. The area's access to major roads and highways ensures that residents can easily commute to other parts of Dubai, making it an ideal location for those who work in the city. With its perfect blend of natural beauty, modern amenities, and strategic location, Majan is a highly desirable destination for those seeking a relaxed and fulfilling lifestyle.
